tasks.title: Implement Registry evidence and traceability
scope: Emit traceable Registry evidence for capability selected/rejected/gap/mismatch outcomes.
Carry capability_version and registry_version in Registry evidence without requiring raw user intent.
Adopt BS-P1-004 Evidence Registry v3 envelope/property ownership rules and canonical Capability ID/version/digest representation.
Close BF-023 by making canonical Evidence intake reject non-UUID-v4 event_id / anonymous_id / session_id / share_id values.
non_scope: Do not change Capability Coverage product semantics.
Do not add new capability IDs or broaden Registry support.

tasks.title: Implement Blueprint validation core and admitted-content persistence
scope: Implement F02 Candidate Blueprint parsing and exact executable schema validation under BS-P1-009.
Implement canonical state TypeDescriptor validation from BS-P1-009.
Implement Value Source contextual typing.
Implement Registry-backed exact capability/version/props/bindings/events/actions/composition validation.
Implement the F04 generated validator machine contract required by BF-031; F02 must consume that generated truth and must not create a second hand-written capability schema.
Persist immutable validation_run / blueprint_content linked to successful validation.
Implement candidate_digest exactly as SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 candidate payload bytes before parse, encoded sha256:<64 lowercase hex>.
Implement staged nullable validation_run.compiler_run_id semantics; do not create a compiler_run FK until compiler persistence exists.
non_scope: Do not implement arbitrary Compiler behavior.
Do not implement user-facing App Shell or Runtime execution.
Do not relax Registry compatibility or trust rules.

tasks.title: Enforce Blueprint execution safety, hard ceilings and trust anti-bypass
scope: Reject arbitrary executable code, executable escape paths and hard-ceiling violations before Runtime under the BS-P1-012 structural allowlist and deterministic V05/V09 resource-owner rules.

Implement Registry v7 canonical machine truth required by BF-040: resource_usage.timerSlotsPerInstance, execution_contract_digest, validator_registry_digest, runtime_registry_digest, runtime_binding_digest, availability/execution_status, execution_class, compatibility, resource budgets/usage and deterministic generated artifacts.

Implement append-only RegistryReleaseLedger truth: immutable release tuples and historical exact CapabilityRef execution_contract_digest + runtime_binding_digest continuity, including remove/re-add history. Same exact ref drift must generation-hard-fail; policy-only lifecycle change requires a new Registry PATCH release tuple.

Implement BF-040 CompatibilityContract grammar exactly: minRuntimeVersion is inclusive bare SemVer; maxRuntimeVersion is required exclusive <SemVer; blueprintSchemaRange only exact, caret, or >=A <B canonical forms. Do not infer alternate grammar.

Enforce V04 required-dependency eligibility recursively and deterministically: matching current-release versions SemVer-descending; candidate must be ENABLED, ACTIVE, supported execution class, Blueprint-schema compatible, trusted-runtime compatible and transitively eligible.
Enforce V11 pinned validation of every support.degradations[].capability_refs[] exact ref using the frozen degradation eligibility contract.

Enforce fresh execution with server-selected trusted pinned/current RegistryReleaseBundle objects, trusted append-only release ledger and actual TrustedRuntimeHandlerCatalog. BlueprintExecutionRefSet is the unique union of Node and degradation refs.

Enforce current-vs-pinned execution_contract_digest and runtime_binding_digest equality for same exact direct/degradation refs and same exact dependency candidates; a new dependency exact version absent pinned may satisfy its declared versionRange only when fully current-eligible.

Enforce durable persisted content integrity and E01-E08 precedence: successful-read body/hash/schema/registry mismatch is F02-ERR-015; deterministic pinned incompatibility is E06/F02-ERR-017; current eligibility is E07/F02-ERR-017; temporary repository/release-ledger/current-release/handler-catalog inability is E08/503 and never fail-open.

Verify pinned RuntimeRegistry identity and pinned direct Node registration keys against server/deployment-owned TrustedRuntimeHandlerCatalog before executable=true; current release may not replace pinned handler binding.

Enforce Phase 1 V10 policy: permission_class only NONE/USER_GESTURE, networkAccessAllowed=false and mediaAutoplayAllowed=false; legitimate code-like strings remain inert data and must not be lexically blacklisted.

Prevent client-supplied trust/executable/version/digest/Registry/release-bundle/runtime-context values from bypassing trusted validation or fresh execution admission; content persistence/reuse never grants execution authority.

TEST-F02-010 must direct-proof the full BF-040 hard-ceiling matrix: V05 initial LIST/STRING value-domain maxima plus every remaining V09 global resource maximum and every static per-Capability budget.
non_scope: Do not add general Runtime feature semantics beyond the F03 H02/H03 pinned-handler safety boundary needed by fresh execution admission.

Do not change locked resource ceiling values, BF-038 measurement formulas, BF-040 V05/V09 ownership, trust states, release identity fields, digest inputs/canonicalization, release-ledger rules or E01-E08 precedence.
Do not infer timer/resource usage from capability IDs, replayClass, handler code or prose.
Do not implement lexical code-keyword blacklisting of legitimate inert user strings.
Do not mutate an existing Registry version or release digest tuple in place to model revoke/disable; policy-only changes require a new Registry PATCH release.
Do not rewrite/delete historical RegistryReleaseLedger entries or permit same exact CapabilityRef execution/runtime-binding identity drift.
Do not derive TrustedRuntimeHandlerCatalog from Registry source; it must represent the actual bundled handler map.
Do not dynamically import or substitute a current handler for an old Blueprint pinned RuntimeRegistry binding.
Do not implement a v6-to-v7 execution compatibility adapter or migration; BS-P1-012 leaves pre-v7 pinned content fail-closed until a future versioned adapter exists.
Do not merge or treat prior candidate HEADs 9740045a82765cf7e4bc629eb06be5010d81f0be or 0be0f7111466ae7f6e27ed5f668a33c37272548d as authoritative; both are review evidence only.

tasks.title: Implement validation failure and degradation semantics
scope: Ensure validation failure never corrupts an existing validated Blueprint and rejected candidate bodies do not become executable durable artifacts.
Enforce explicit PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED degradation metadata and semantic-core preservation.
non_scope: Do not implement the browser proof for F02-AC-017; that proof is isolated in T009.
Do not invent new degradation policy beyond locked BS-P1-012.

tasks.title: Implement validation evidence and admission traceability
scope: Make every F02 validation mechanically traceable by deterministic candidate_digest, terminal status, stage/error and canonical trace_id; missing or malformed upstream trace must be replaced at the trusted F02 boundary with a server-generated F07-canonical trace before validation_run/evidence construction.

Emit validation/admission Evidence through the locked F02/F07 event contracts without raw Blueprint body or raw Intent telemetry; preserve non-blocking Evidence delivery semantics and existing fresh execution-admission events F02-EVT-010..013 where applicable.
Make admitted Blueprint content mechanically traceable to its immutable admitting validation_run and reject broken/tampered lineage.

Implement trusted server-only compare-and-set Blueprint trust transitions VALIDATED→REVOKED|INCOMPATIBLE; successful transitions emit F02-EVT-008 / F02-EVT-014 with canonical trace and must not mutate immutable Blueprint body or admitting lineage.

Preserve validator-private issuance authenticity for PASSED, REJECTED and INCOMPATIBLE terminal validation reports; fabricated/copy/relabel/proxy/accessor results must not create durable validation_run evidence.
non_scope: Do not change Product validation/trust semantics, Build Spec, Evidence Registry semantics or governance truth.
Do not store raw Blueprint body or raw Intent in telemetry Evidence.
Do not implement terminal trust recovery REVOKED/INCOMPATIBLE→VALIDATED, admin UX, or new trust policy beyond the locked trusted transition boundary.
Do not absorb POI-005 production HTTP / Runtime / Postgres boundary wiring; testable repository/service ports are allowed only as required by T005.
Do not implement T009 / F02-AC-017 browser proof or activate T006-T009.

tasks.title: Implement Intent Envelope, clarification policy and visible assumptions
scope: Implement StructuredIntentEnvelope source precedence and deterministic clarification policy.

Require explicit clarification for money/permission/cost assumptions, expose material proposals, avoid re-asking answered questions unless upstream facts change, and prevent client resolved_intent bypass.

Honor BS-P1-004 F01 Evidence source ownership: product_event carries bounded event dimensions; compiler economics remain compiler_run truth; clarification-policy triggered-rule truth is not invented in product_event.
non_scope: Do not implement LLM provider integration or full Compiler composition.
Do not implement the browser proof for F01-AC-002; that proof is isolated in T009.

tasks.title: Implement durable client evidence queue, expiry, overflow priority and pagehide flush
scope: Add durable client evidence buffering with maximum 24-hour TTL and bounded queue/storage limits.
On overflow, preferentially retain CORE_OUTCOME / RELIABILITY over DEBUG / PRODUCT_SAMPLE.
Implement best-effort pagehide/visibility flush using the locked browser-safe transport boundary.
non_scope: Do not implement raw product_event retention/deletion policy; that is T008.
Do not make the evidence queue a durable source of Product truth.

tasks.title: Implement evidence retention, aggregate survival and drop/expiry observability
scope: Implement executable 90-day raw product_event retention/deletion behavior while allowing non-identifying aggregate counts/rates to remain.
Make rejection/drop/queue-expiry observable and prevent DEBUG_ONLY events from durable production storage by default.
Implement appf2-owned EvidenceRetentionMaintenance semantics with received_at as the 90-day raw-retention cutoff.
Persist bounded non-identifying evidence_daily_aggregate data before raw deletion and fail closed unless aggregate watermark coverage is verified.
non_scope: Do not define final cross-function Product metrics from BL-P1-034.
Do not weaken F07 privacy allowlists or identity boundaries.

tasks.title: Add SP2 real-browser verification harness for clarification and explicit result proof
scope: Create a minimal test-only browser verification harness under tests/e2e that calls the already implemented SP2 production logic and renders its returned state/output for Playwright verification.
Prove F01-AC-002 by showing NEEDS_CLARIFICATION when required intent data is missing and no safe default exists.
Prove F02-AC-017 by showing explicit result.outputs from the validation result contract rather than inferring a result from a UI tree.
Use existing Playwright + npm run build/test:e2e toolchain; a test support server/page may be added under tests/e2e and wired through playwright.config.ts.
non_scope: This is not the SP4 Create shell and not the SP5 product App surface.
Do not create production navigation, styling, dashboard/chat UI, or new Product behavior.
Do not duplicate F01/F02 logic inside the test harness; the harness must exercise production modules.
